title: How Typhoon Champi became one of the strongest storms of the year — and why El Niño is to blame
desc: Typhoon Champi became the planet's strongest storm of 2026, a Category 5 super typhoon with winds of 185 mph. It approached Taiwan bringing a typhoon holiday, and scientists link its strength to the record-breaking El Niño heating up the Pacific Ocean.
